title: arctanthemum kurilense
intro: Arctanthemum kurilense, commonly known as the Kuril Sea Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Arctanthemum kurilense may include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising candidate for further research. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
